bluf: SDIM is a Haarlem full service digital agency founded in 2006 with 48 staff, selling strategy through execution to ecommerce, B2B and non profit clients across eight core lines, paid search, paid social, programmatic, SEO, CRO, data, AI search and AI automation, with no single lead line. The record shows it moving into AI on three fronts, AI consultancy and agents, ChatGPT Ads, and GEO measurement with Peec AI in a Sep 2026 article, while advertising for SEO and GEO specialists on LinkedIn. Horus reads Favored at 21.4, best placed for KJ6; Monsoon reads Breeze at 48.5. What a rival should know: all 27 listed clients carry observed work, the non profit book is the spine, and its own house contradicts two of the lines it sells.
doing:
The positioning line, a Haarlem full service digital agency since 2006 running strategy through execution with data driven, no nonsense specialists for ecommerce, B2B and non profits, decodes as a generalist performance shop with a named non profit specialism: it partners with Goede Doelen Nederland and organises annual non profit events. The headline claim is self described #1 digital marketing specialist, listed in the Emerce top 100, with 20+ years' experience; the site schema also lists an FD Gazelle Award and FONK150 Best Agencies.

The sold mix has no lead line and eight core lines at score 2. AI Automation / Agents, on an AI navigation group selling consultancy, agents, readiness and training. AI Search / GEO, on a ChatGPT Ads service page, the Sep 2026 Peec AI article and a GEO specialist vacancy. CRO, on BENU A/B testing that raised value per visitor 11.2%. Data & Measurement, on a data and automation pillar covering BI, warehouse, GA and server side tracking, with an NRC attribution case. Paid Search, on a Google Ads line, a PPC case using generative AI and three advertising team leads on staff. Paid Social, on Burgerbar, NRC Media and Pay4you LinkedIn cases. Programmatic & CTV, on display and programmatic lines with a Jopen programmatic DOOH case and YouTube video cases. SEO, on Nedstar organic traffic and Sanquin migration cases. B2B, content and PR, creator, email, retail media and web score 1; local scores 0. Breadth is 14. The record lists no proprietary product and no formal partners.

Its AI posture is three offers at once: consultancy, agents, readiness and training; ChatGPT Ads; and client GEO measurement with Peec AI, a third party tool. The Horus read scores P6 and P8 as making and P1 partial, because the GEO measurement is a tool it uses rather than an audited product it owns.

The record holds no dated moves, no news, no case study list beyond the client pages and no jobs, though its LinkedIn ads hire an Advertising Specialist and an SEO and GEO specialist.

The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for a performance agency of this breadth: any proprietary technology, and any social pixel or testing tool on its own site.
clients:

The record lists 27 clients, 17 with case studies and 10 with slugs, and all 27 carry an observed need: names only are 0. As the record computes it, the needs read codes every client as local and lead generation, N10, at 0.894 of the mix, with five carrying a second code: Mom in Balance, PR, N12, on a digital PR case; vtwonen, AI, N9, on a Conversed AI chatbot campaign via Facebook; Jopen, paid, N2, on digital out of home advertising; Hostnet, web, N4, on the ugliest website of the year case; Urban Arrow, data, N5, on server side tracking. The non profit book is the spine: Cordaid (recruiting a young donor audience), Fonds Gehandicaptensport (a collection campaign), Terre des Hommes (an influencer campaign), KNGF (a year end campaign), Diabetes Fonds (a national sugar challenge), UNHCR, Save the Children (YouTube for action) and Rode Kruis (an earthquake campaign, aardbeving Marokko). Commerce and media names include BENU (A/B testing), NRC (attribution), Le Marais (14 percent revenue growth), Online Deurbeslagshop (a bol case), Voordelig Design Sanitair, Surfana, Urban Iki (an A/B test) and Omroep West; Sanquin came for a recruitment campaign and Gemeente Altena for a resident budget concept. Burgerbar, Nedstar, Fundustry and Pay4you (a LinkedIn case) complete the list.

One client is shared: Save the Children also sits on the outerbox book.

What the base needs next: the record says it is best placed for KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, driven by AI Automation / Agents, a tailwind, and for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation, and most exposed to KJ5, the price of attention splits in two, driven by Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that its non profit clients will buy AI agents and readiness training next, which it already advertises, and likely, with low confidence, that the same clients will press paid social and programmatic on price as KJ5 splits the market.

openings:
The strongest opening is the pair of observed contradictions: it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site, and it sells CRO with no testing tool detected on its homepage. It is very likely, with high confidence, that a rival who shows a non profit or ecommerce prospect the tag stack of sdim.nl, gtm alone, leads with a finding the agency cannot answer in the room; the falsifier is a social pixel or a testing tool appearing on the homepage at the next compile.

The book is hard to contest on evidence, all 27 clients with observed work, so the play is the line, not the name: KJ5 exposure on Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV, the lines the house contradicts, makes the non profit paid social accounts, Cordaid, Terre des Hommes, KNGF, Diabetes Fonds, the ones a rival with a walled garden price story approaches, likely, with low confidence.

The gap beside it is P1: GEO measured with Peec AI, a third party tool, and no audited visibility product of its own, so a rival with an owned citation scorecard leads with the number; P2 is absent, so feed, schema and entity work is unclaimed on a core SEO line. P5 is unknown, and displacement 50.0 makes an offshore undercut on SEO and paid search hours roughly even chance to land. The sitemap read, 0 URLs updated in 365 days, is a question rather than a finding, since the status note dates content to Sep 2026.
